free_tier.stated: RTX 4090 rental quoted at CNY 20 of credit to every new registration (新人注册), with 4090, A800 and H800 cards cut permanently in price. A price aggregator that polls vendor pages daily records the 4090 at USD 0.267 per card-hour on demand, USD 0.18 preemptible and USD 0.224 on a monthly rate for a cn-north-b instance.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A CNY 20 registration credit is one evening of 4090 time, which is enough to benchmark a model against a rented 3090 elsewhere before committing a deposit.
limits_note: The CNY 20 credit is the first thing to run out: at USD 0.267 an hour for a 4090 it buys about 11 hours at the CNY 6.67 rate the aggregator applies, and the account then needs a deposit.

identity_cost.detail: The signup form was not read. The provider is a mainland company selling in CNY, and every comparable mainland host requires a mobile number plus real-name certification, but this record does not establish it.

evidence.proved: front page states ¥20 新人注册丹摩 (CNY 20 for a new registration at Damodel) and 4090、A800、H800等卡型永久降价, quoted
aggregator lists 丹摩 DAMODEL RTX 4090 at USD 0.267 on demand, USD 0.18 spot and USD 0.224 monthly for cn-north-b, refreshed within 24 hours

notes: The vendor page states the credit but not the price table for each card, so the hourly rate is `reported` by the aggregator while the credit is `documented` by the vendor; the weakest rung governs, which is why this entry is documented for the credit and reported for the rate in the evidence list. Open question: whether the CNY 20 credit can be spent without a deposit, which decides between trial-only and paid-only.
